title: Network Security: VPC-SC & Cloud Armor — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Cloud Armor Adaptive Protection: automated machine learning detects a Layer 7 HTTP flood attack, generates a custom WAF signature, and blocks attack traffic.
routing_rationale: Adaptive Protection analyzes traffic baselines using machine learning, automatically producing targeted rules to neutralize novel zero-day application attacks.

nodes.label: L7 HTTP Flood (1M QPS)
nodes.detail: Botnet sends 1,000,000 requests/sec with rotating User-Agent strings.

nodes.label: Adaptive Threat Analyzer
nodes.detail: Identifies common attack fingerprint in HTTP headers within 45 seconds.

nodes.label: Dynamic WAF Rule Generated
nodes.product: Rule: deny if header matches signature
nodes.detail: Generates rule with confidence score 0.98; deploys to edge proxy in 2 seconds.

nodes.label: Edge Traffic Drop (HTTP 429)
nodes.detail: Drops 99.8% of botnet traffic at edge PoPs worldwide; backend origin CPU drops to 20%.

steps.title: Anomaly Identification
steps.action: Adaptive Protection ML correlates requests across 100k IPs and extracts distinguishing header.
steps.why_traversal: Identifies complex distributed attacks that evade simple rate limiters.

steps.title: Automated Edge Mitigation
steps.action: Cloud Armor deploys targeted rule to all edge points of presence, dropping flood packets.
steps.why_traversal: Protects backend web servers from exhaustion and eliminates origin egress charges.

scenarios.label: Overly Broad Signature Drops Legitimate Users
scenarios.root_cause: Signature used common header shared by legitimate mobile application users.
scenarios.recovery: Deploy Adaptive Protection rules in preview mode first and refine signature with multi-attribute matching.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
